note: Main design for the corpus-v3 sets (hard sets and validity set), decided 23/11/2026 (docs/decisions.md 22/11 and 23/11, plan docs/planning/dk2-dk4-improvement-2026-11-22.md). DK1 is the main 128-token chunking (128/21 as dk1-128.json, chosen 12/11/2026) with the document-level validity filter of DK1-hl (same parameters as validity/dk1-hl.json): under validity option B DK2 filters by the documents' vbpl.vn dates, so DK1 gets the same source metadata and the DK1-DK2 comparison isolates the chunking. Dates at the question's as_of, else shared.validity_as_of. Packing is always P0 for DK1.
